discoveryNotes: Created by hand for the Japan scan: toysrus.co.jp is Cloudflare-blocked so brand_discovery cannot run. Players (tier, relationship, verified URL, handles linked from each homepage) seeded from scrapers/jp_competitors.js, approved set 2026-11-18. Don Quijote is the PARTNER, never scored as a competitor. Unverified candidates are listed in JP_UNVERIFIED there.

scrape.note: toysrus.co.jp is geo-fenced to Japan. skipApifyRetry keeps every direct request and the generic Apify retry off. Reading is allowed only through the authorized Japanese residential proxy in access (utils/site_access.js), a few read-only pages per module per run. The manual capture in data/brands/toysrus-jp/manual_capture/toysrus-jp.html (and .png) is the fallback when the proxied load fails.

access.reason: Site is geo-fenced to Japan to keep sales in the licensed territory; brand owner authorized read-only review through a Japanese proxy
